1.21.1.4.0.1: Deeper Down 4.0.1: update notices now come straight from the CypressFox repo. Plays exactly like 4.0.0.
1.21.1.4.0.0: Deeper Down 4.0.0: route-based endings (the Hollow Watcher, the Sculk Choir, the Gilded Warlord and the Shulker Admiral at the top of the new Ascent), Delvers, completion marks, Trials and a Journal; seeded runs and a daily dungeon with its own board; rooms twice as wide with 100 new room layouts and overhauled corridors; traps (spikes, arrow walls, fire jets, collapsing floors, crushers). Same seed, same dungeon on the same version; runs paused on 3.0.1 rebuild their floor.
1.21.1.3.0.1: Deeper Down 3.0.1: works with FoxTrot 4.0 (the dungeon music pauses while you play a FoxTrot song again). Needs FoxTrot 4.0 or newer if you have FoxTrot.
1.21.1.3.0.0: Deeper Down 3.0.0: the dungeon is its own mod now. Works on its own (craft a Descent), with Cobblemon (party battles) or with PokéShift (as before). Pit and lava rooms are parkour-or-die if you're not the type they're for.
